text: Software Interface – java version 1.4.0 is required to use the software.
Multicast Protocol – in order to send multicast message, network environment such as router, network card and operating systems must support multicast protocol.
agentMom shall support the ability to send unicast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to receive unicast message.
Unicast message shall only be received by the specified address.
Unicast message shall arrive at the specified address and in order.
agentMom shall support the ability to send multicast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to receive multicast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to send request to join multicast group.
agentMom shall support the ability to send request to leave multicast group.
agentMom shall not allow receiving multicast message from a group before joining that multicast group.
agentMom shall not allow receiving multicast message from a group after leaving that multicast group.
agentMom shall support the ability to set time-to-live for multicast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to set multicast address and port for sending and receiving multicast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to receive multicast message from multiple groups.
agentMom shall support the ability to sent broadcast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to receive broadcast message.
Broadcast message shall be sent to all possible hosts under the same local network.
agentMom shall support the ability to encrypt unicast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to decrypt unicast message.
agentMom shall allow an agent to decide whether or not to encrypt a message.
agentMom shall automatically decrypt encrypted message.
agentMom shall support the ability to encrypt multicast message.
agentMom shall support the ability to decrypt multicast message.
agentMom with shall support the use of the architecture that agent directly controls the conversations.
agentMom shall support the use of the architecture that agent’s components control the conversations.
The new built agentMom shall be compatible with the agentMom 1.2 Note: The “ * ” indicates Driving Requirements that need to be demonstrated by the end of phase II.
